boundary: Bounded adversarial evidence over a named forgery family, not a formal soundness proof. The apex re-checks numeric homeostasis grounds (H1/H3), rejects report-only runs, and re-derives H4 from the substrate; substrate data artifacts are trusted-as-data (manifest-hash / commit-acceptor gated).

forge homeostasis coherence; apex ignores it (re-derives from real controllers)
forge a report-only flag on the homeostasis artifact; defeated by H4 (aggregator rejects report-only)
forge the final verdict to PASS while a substrate is FAIL
